Chapter 437: Chapter 10: Interstellar Migration (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 437: Chapter 10: Interstellar Migration (Please Subscribe)

The size of the inner world.

It was influenced by two aspects.

The first was the internal factor.

The second was the external factor.

The internal factor was the strength of the physical body, and the degree of understanding of the Space Rules, among other things.

Normally, the deeper the understanding of the Space Rules, the more core space models would be comprehended, and thus the larger the inner world would grow.

...

As for physical strength? It was difficult to significantly enhance physical strength in a short period of time.

However, slowly enhancing physical strength over a long period until reaching its limit was not difficult at all.

So,

for human Eighth Rank Evolvers, there were basically no problems in terms of the physical body.

As for external factors, they were some space-related rare treasures,

such as the incredibly precious ‘World Fruit,’ which could forcibly expand the size of the inner world when it was being established.

However, such an expansion was one-time, and if a Seventh-Rank Peak Evolver used the ‘World Fruit’ for the first time,

they would create an inner world spanning thousands of miles.

To further expand this inner world of thousands of miles would require the Evolver to enhance their understanding of Space Rules to a corresponding degree,

exceeding the understanding of a world spanning thousands of miles.

But now—

Lin Yuan’s understanding of Space Rules had not significantly increased.

He had not used rare treasures such as the ‘World Fruit.’

Yet, his inner world had inexplicably doubled in size… This was simply shocking.

“This?!”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

The inner world was the foundation of an Eighth Rank Evolver, even affecting Ninth Rank Evolvers, and even Tenth Rank Evolvers.

When two Eighth Rank Evolvers fought, one with an inner world spanning 100,000 miles and the other 50,000 miles,

without any other decisive factors influencing, the battle would end in a crushing defeat.

The scarlet liquid in the gourd immediately doubled the size of Lin Yuan’s inner world, and its effect on combat power would far exceed doubling.

“And—”

Lin Yuan carefully sensed for a while and discovered an even more astonishing fact.

It was not merely an increase, but a foundational increase.

What is a foundational increase?

Normally, an Eighth Rank Evolver starts with an inner world spanning approximately a hundred miles.

Afterward, by constantly comprehending the laws of space and enhancing physical strength, theoretically, if they mastered the complete Space Laws at the Eighth Rank,

the size of their inner world would reach ten million miles in diameter.

This is the theoretical upper limit for an Eighth Rank Evolver.

Very few Eighth Rank Evolvers could expand their inner worlds to such an extent; understanding Complete Space Rules? Even some Ninth Rank Evolvers haven’t comprehended them, let alone Eighth Rank ones.

Lin Yuan’s foundational increase was not just an additional 700,000 miles on the ten million mile basis,

rather, for Lin Yuan, the theoretical upper limit of an Eighth Rank Evolver directly became twenty million miles.

This impact would definitely not be limited to the Eighth Rank; as Lin Yuan stepped into the Ninth Rank, and even the Tenth Rank, he would gain a tremendous advantage amongst peers at the same level.

….

“Incredible.”

“Truly incredible.”

Lin Yuan’s heart did not settle for a long time.

Even he had never imagined that there would be such methods in the universe that could break the shackles of species.

Worlds spanning ten million miles were the shackles of human Eighth Rank Evolvers.

But certain special lifeforms had inner worlds exceeding this limit.

For instance, the peak bloodline special lifeform Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, these lifeforms have an upper limit far beyond that of humans.

But there was no help for it.

Species differed from each other.

“This is just the first drop of the scarlet liquid, and I have not yet fully assimilated this drop, and there are six more grades of liquid to absorb, what will the upper limit of my inner world reach? Perhaps it will reach how many million miles? Or even billions of miles?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking once again at the grey-red gourd in front of him.

If the size of the inner world reaches several tens of millions of miles or even billions,

then even if Lin Yuan did not master some type of cosmic force, he could still grind those invincible Eighth Ranks into the ground.

The so-called Cosmic Force was just another means to greatly enhance an Eighth Rank Evolver’s capabilities, just as a vast inner world could do the same.

“Opportunity.”

“This is undoubtedly an invaluable opportunity, even for a Supreme Being, to shatter racial shackles, and even far exceed such shackles, is very hard to achieve.”

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

Supreme Beings towered above all, transcending the universe, able to cause permanent damage to the Main World.

But that was all by themselves; if it were for other Evolvers to break limits and shackles, it would surely come at a great cost.

“This gourd must absolutely not be revealed,” Lin Yuan decided internally.

He could inform Human Civilization about the second way to join the Magic Jade Tower as an ordinary member because it had no impact on himself.

Whether it’s one member of the Magic Jade Tower or ten, it made little difference.

And to comprehend all 3,333 Evolution Paths in a short time was definitely not possible.

But there was only one gourd like this for Lin Yuan; told the Goddess of Wisdom, what would Lin Yuan do if a Supreme Being requested to borrow it?

“Continue.”

Lin Yuan shook the grey-red gourd.

Then he turned the mouth of the gourd downwards.

Before long,

another drop of scarlet liquid formed at the mouth of the gourd.

The drop of scarlet liquid Lin Yuan had previously ingested had not been completely absorbed in the end, but had transformed his physical body to ashes.

To fully absorb the liquid, he must persist until that fire, which burns everything, is extinguished.

…

Time passed.

Six months later,

on the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.
